main_text.l: legendum docent Hebraei תשכלי Orbibis, Ezech.36.14. Hiphil הכשיל Impingere, Ruere fecit, Labefactavit. Hophal מכשלים Impingere facti.
מכשול m. Offendiculum, Offensio: plural, מכשולים Offendicula.
מכשף m. Praestigiator: מכשפה Praestigiatrix. כשפים m. p. Praestigiatores. כשפם Praestigiae.
ישר Rectum esse. Hiphil הכשיר Rectificare, Dirigere.
כתב Scribere, Describere, &c. Sic Chald. כתב Scripsit, כתבו Scripserunt: כתבן Scribentes. כתיב Scriptum. Niphal Heb. נכתב Scribi. Pihel כתב Scripsit.
כתב m. Scriptum, Scriptura: Chald. כתבא Idem fem. כתבה vel כתבא.

page.notes: Hebrew words in the entries are read from a faded scan; those marked by the text are uncertain where the vowel points or letters blur, and the second Hebrew word in the Hiphil line and the Chaldee forms may contain errors. The running head is Hebrew.
